name: dhanya-progress
description: A pane beside the chat that shows what is done, in progress, blocked, what you need to do, and open pull requests and deploys for the Dhanya project. It keeps itself up to date.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the pane re-reads the small files and the Codex runs. GitHub is asked every 2 minutes and the tracker is fetched every 5 minutes. The Refresh button does everything at once.

sprintFile.title: Progress tracker file
sprintFile.description: Fallback: the local sprint-status.yaml, used only when git cannot give the remote copy.

needsFile.title: What-you-need file
needsFile.description: The owner-needs.json file that lists what the owner needs to do or decide.

codexRunsDir.title: Codex runs folder
codexRunsDir.description: Where the Codex bridge writes its run files. The pane lists these runs next to the other agents.

repoDir.title: Project checkout folder
repoDir.description: The git checkout that holds docs/plan/sprint-status.yaml. The pane runs git fetch there and reads origin/main.

githubRepo.title: GitHub repository
githubRepo.description: The owner/name that gh lists pull requests and workflow runs for.
